title: Battle of Danghangpo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Danghangpo", at revision 1370438295, opens: "The Battle of Danghangpo was a naval engagement during the Japanese invasions of Korea (1592–98) that resulted in Korean victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q626283, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1592 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
